text:
mike: quick heads-up — profiling of tonight's AWQ 7B nightly run shows OOMs on p4d when seq_len spikes to 2048. looks like KV cache is being inflated by unexpected casts.

sara: ugh. wasn’t that addressed in the fp8 rollout? :confused:

mike: we switched matmul kernels to fp8, but the allocator reclamation path calls into fallback kernels which require float32 workspaces. that triggers a cast of cached KV tensors during a reclaim and doubles memory temporarily. stack trace / snippet below.

perfbot: [profile] 2026-03-15T10:12Z - top allocations pre-fix: kv_cache=1.9GB, workspace=1.8GB, temp_buffers=1.2GB, peak=6.0GB

josh: can you paste the minimal repro?

mike: repro command:
```
python -m perf.run --model awq-7b --seq 2048 --batch 2 --quant awq --kernel_policy smart
```

kevin: short-term mitigation: keep KV cache dtype as fp16 on-device (cast on load/store) even if activations are processed in fp8/gptq path. should cut cache footprint ~45%.

caroline: watch out for mixed-precision interactions. last time AMP+cudnn auto-tuner picked a different kernel and we saw subtle numeric drift on the eval suite. need guarded regression tests.

sara: allocator idea: instead of full slab reflow when a large workspace is requested, introduce a "mini-pool reclaim" path that tries to reuse smaller free chunks and grows lazily. avoids allocating temporary float32 workspaces that force KV casts.

mike: implemented mini-pool reuse + a hysteresis threshold for kernel fallback (only fallback after 3 consecutive failures). running canary now.

perfbot: [profile] 2026-03-15T11:02Z - after mini-pool+kv-fp16: kv_cache=1.0GB, workspace=1.1GB, temp_buffers=0.6GB, peak=3.0GB. OOMs reduced from 7 -> 0 across 1000 runs. latency p50 +3% for batch=2.

josh: +3% p50 seems ok given stability improvement. can we gate this with a runtime flag?

kevin: adding config flag: `runtime.memory.reuse_kv_override=true` and rollout as canary 5% initially. will add to console toggles.

caroline: checklist before full rollout: 1) numeric parity unit tests for fp16 vs fp32 KV paths, 2) run full eval suite on 3 datasets, 3) update perf docs (kernel selection notes), 4) release note about AWQ caveat. I'll own eval.

mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 (implements mini-pool, kv fp16 on cache, and fallback hysteresis). staging runs scheduled in 1h.

sara: also add a note in the docs: AWQ/GPTQ fp8 kernels don't support split-k caching on current driver — add to model onboarding checklist.

mike: filing follow-up issue for mixed-precision autopromote bug that caused occasional kernel mismatches. ticket #830.

kevin: :thumbsup:
